residences.name: Mens Made for More House
houseRules: Zero tolerance for alcohol, illicit drugs, or unapproved mind-altering substances on or off premises.
Mandatory attendance at the weekly Sunday House Meeting (7:00 PM).
Adhere to daily curfews: 10:00 PM Sunday-Thursday, 11:00 PM Friday-Saturday.
Complete assigned daily household chores by 9:00 PM every evening.
Attend a minimum of 4 verified 12-Step / recovery mutual aid meetings per week.
Submit to random urine drug screens (UDS) and alcohol breathalyzers upon request.
Respect fellow residents: quiet hours 11:00 PM to 6:00 AM; no guests permitted in resident bedrooms.
Notify House Manager at least 24 hours in advance for overnight pass requests.
